ToD_A01_M03_VO_S001_002.source_old: Lok’tar! Our mighty Armada will arrive in these waters soon, ushering in our long awaited assault on Lordaeron. All that we have done here has led us to this moment.
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S001_002.source_new: Lok’tar! Our mighty Armada will arrive in these waters soon, ushering in our long awaited assault on Lordaeron. All that we have done here has led us to this moment.

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S001_003.source_old: To ensure that the Armada will be operating at maximum efficiency, the Warchief has directed us to begin construction of facilities for them near the Southshore region.
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S001_003.source_new: To ensure that the Armada will be operating at maximum efficiency, the Warchief has directed us to begin construction of facilities for them near the Southshore region.

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S001_004.source_old: He also instructs us to build a fleet of our own, so that we may keep these facilities safe against any Alliance incursions.
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S001_004.source_new: He also instructs us to build a fleet of our own, so that we may keep these facilities safe against any Alliance incursions.

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S001_005.source_old: Accomplishing both of these tasks will require massive amounts of the black liquid known as oil.
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S001_005.source_new: Accomplishing both of these tasks will require massive amounts of the black liquid known as oil.

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S001_006.source_old: The local waters are rich with this resource, and recent ice melts have made it even more of it accessible. But some deposits may be guarded by alliance ships.
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S001_006.source_new: The local waters are rich with this resource, and recent ice melts have made it even more of it accessible. But some deposits may be guarded by alliance ships.

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S001_007.source_old: We will need to build a shipyard and oil tankers in order to extract this resource.
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S001_007.source_new: We will need to build a shipyard and oil tankers in order to extract this resource.

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S001_008.source_old: Once our task is completed and our Armada arrives, the invasion of Lordaeron can finally begin… starting with Hillsbrad.
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S001_008.source_new: Once our task is completed and our Armada arrives, the invasion of Lordaeron can finally begin… starting with Hillsbrad.

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S002_004.source_old: I owe you my life, Zul’jin! Thank you for killing those cowardly elves.
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S002_004.source_new: I owe you my life, Zul’jin! Thank you for killing those cowardly elves.

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S002_005.source_old: My pleasure, Rend Blackhand! You and I be brothers now, and brothers be looking out for one another!
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S002_005.source_new: My pleasure, Rend Blackhand! You and I be brothers now, and brothers be looking out for one another!

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S002_006.source_old: My axes be thirsting for da blood of da humans and elves who took me, my warriors and I be here to aid ya in the battles ahead!
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S002_006.source_new: My axes be thirsting for da blood of da humans and elves who took me, my warriors and I be here to aid ya in the battles ahead!

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S002_007.source_old: I am glad that you came here. Together we will establish Horde authority over these seas.
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S002_007.source_new: I am glad that you came here. Together we will establish Horde authority over these seas.

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S003_001.source_old: The pathetic humans got to the island before us! Find their camp and burn it to the ground!
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S003_001.source_new: The pathetic humans got to the island before us! Find their camp and burn it to the ground!

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S004_001.source_old: Thanks for freeing us mon! We should hurry, da elves said dat the Gilneans be planning something big!
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S004_001.source_new: Thanks for freeing us mon! We should hurry, da elves said dat the Gilneans be planning something big!

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S004_002.source_old: The Gilneans? Chieftain, perhaps we should warn the Armada? Gilneas should not be...
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S004_002.source_new: The Gilneans? Chieftain, perhaps we should warn the Armada? Gilneas should not be...

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S004_003.source_old: Nonsense! The Orcish Armada is the greatest naval force in orcish history… if the Gilneans are foolish enough to stand in their way, then let them sail to their doom!
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S004_003.source_new: Nonsense! The Orcish Armada is the greatest naval force in orcish history… if the Gilneans are foolish enough to stand in their way, then let them sail to their doom!

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S005_001.source_old: That’s the last of them. Now we can focus on our main task, without hindrance.
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S005_001.source_new: That’s the last of them. Now we can focus on our main task, without hindrance.

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S006_001.source_old: Dis be the Destroyer. These ships be swift and deadly. Dey can shoot at both ground and air targets. Dey will be indispensable in naval battles with da Alliance.
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S006_001.source_new: Dis be the Destroyer. These ships be swift and deadly. Dey can shoot at both ground and air targets. Dey will be indispensable in naval battles with da Alliance.

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S007_001.source_old: Chieftain! There is a force of battleships anchored in Southshore, they could set sail at any moment!
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S007_001.source_new: Chieftain! There is a force of battleships anchored in Southshore, they could set sail at any moment!

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S007_002.source_old: Lok'Narash! They must not be allowed to threaten our operations here, destroy them immediately!
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S007_002.source_new: Lok'Narash! They must not be allowed to threaten our operations here, destroy them immediately!

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S008_001.source_old: Chieftain, this human tanker carried oil, maybe we can pillage more oil from these pathetic humans?
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S008_001.source_new: Chieftain, this human tanker carried oil, maybe we can pillage more oil from these pathetic humans?

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S008_002.source_old: Excellent idea Utok! This way we can claim even more oil, while striking a crippling blow against our enemies.
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S008_002.source_new: Excellent idea Utok! This way we can claim even more oil, while striking a crippling blow against our enemies.

ToD_A01_M03_VO_S009_001.source_old: Excellent! Our tankers are bursting with oil, now nothing can stop us from destroying Hillsbrad!
ToD_A01_M03_VO_S009_001.source_new: Excellent! Our tankers are bursting with oil, now nothing can stop us from destroying Hillsbrad!
